resolutions.researcher_notes: Original live current_ref (youm7.com) is dead; revived via Wayback (2020 capture, HTTP 200, content verified). Youm7 (2016-06-07) is the Egyptian Ministry of Petroleum's published map/schedule of gas trunk lines feeding new power plants: it itemizes 'محطة كهرباء المحمودية بطول 52 كم، وتكلفة 637 مليون جنيه' (Mahmoudiya power-station line, 52 km, EGP 637 million) with planned delivery/operation in September 2017. Cross-checked against two independent World Bank documents for the same project (EG-Giza North Power Project, P116194): the 2016/2017 ESIA (documents1.worldbank.org/.../SFG1795-V7-EA-P116194...txt, verified OK) which describes 'El Mahmodia Power Station (27 km + 17 km + 7 km) + gas decompression station' -- length sums to 51 km, consistent with the 52 km figure (rounding/measurement basis differs slightly) -- and the 2018 Independent Evaluation Group ICR Review (documents1.worldbank.org/.../Egypt-Arab-Republic-of-EG-Giza-North-Power-Project.pdf) which confirms four of the six power-plant gas pipelines financed under this project were completed by the loan's closing date (31-Dec-2017), consistent with Youm7's stated Sept-2017 delivery target for this line. Neither World Bank document names the Mahmoudiya line specifically as 'completed'/'operating' (the ICR aggregates across six lines), so this is not a fully independent second confirmation of current operating status -- it corroborates existence, length, and the completion timeframe, but the 'operating' status rests primarily on the original Youm7 schedule plus the plausible inference that the line was in service on schedule (~2017) and feeds the Mahmoudiya power plant, which is itself an established operating station. No contradiction found; no source states the line was delayed, dropped, or is still under construction. Recommend medium tier pending a source that names this specific line as commissioned.

Same revived Youm7 source (Wayback 2020 capture, verified) is the only source found that itemizes SegmentCost = EGP 637 million specifically for this 52 km Mahmoudiya line, in a table listing per-line cost/length/delivery-date for six GASCO power-plant feeder lines (New Capital/Berlus/Beni Suef-Siemens 320 km @ EGP 3bn; Suez 3 km @ EGP 50m; South Helwan 1.2 km @ EGP 90m; 6th of October 0.4 km @ EGP 28m; Mahmoudiya 52 km @ EGP 637m; Damanhour 2.5 km @ EGP 82m). Searched World Bank ESIA/ICR project documents (EG-Giza North Power Project, P116194) for a corroborating per-line EGP cost figure -- they give only project-level USD totals (e.g. 'Gas pipeline component: Actual US$316 million' across all lines, not broken out per line) and do not restate the EGP 637m figure, so I could not find a second, independent source with the exact same cost value. No contradiction found (the World Bank aggregate cost is consistent with, not contrary to, a ~637m EGP allocation to one of several lines), but corroboration is single-source -- flagging as medium tier rather than high.
